tasks.category: Ensure readiness for assignment.
tasks.verbatim_text: Obtain and assemble information and materials needed for kit. Suggested items:
clarifications: Agency specific forms/materials appropriate to the Human Resource Specialist function
Office supplies appropriate to the function

tasks.category: Ensure readiness for assignment.
tasks.verbatim_text: Obtain complete information from dispatch upon assignment.

tasks.category: Ensure readiness for assignment.
tasks.verbatim_text: Arrive at incident and check in.
clarifications: Arrive properly equipped at assigned location within acceptable time limits.

tasks.category: Ensure availability, qualifications, and capabilities of resources to complete assignment.
tasks.verbatim_text: Install a workstation within the first operational period following check-in.
clarifications: Identifiable with Human Resource Specialist sign and availability information.
Adequate space for two or more persons.

tasks.category: Ensure availability, qualifications, and capabilities of resources to complete assignment.
tasks.verbatim_text: Obtain phone/radio from Communications Unit.

tasks.category: Ensure availability, qualifications, and capabilities of resources to complete assignment.
tasks.verbatim_text: Order additional Human Resource Specialists if needed.
clarifications: Ensure prompt advice and assistance to managers/supervisors with resolution of issues.

tasks.category: Gather, update, and apply situational information relevant to the assignment.
tasks.verbatim_text: Gather information necessary to assess incident assignment and determine immediate needs and actions.
clarifications: Incident Commander’s/supervisor’s name and location; make contact.

tasks.category: Gather, update, and apply situational information relevant to the assignment.
tasks.verbatim_text: Obtain and assemble cooperating and assisting agency information for use in answering requests and resolving problems.
clarifications: Contact persons (e.g., Interagency Resource Representative, Contracting Officer’s Technical Representative, Crew Representatives).
Policies on civil rights, Equal Employment Opportunity (EEO), sexual harassment, appropriate behavior.
Number and types of contracts, contractors, and contractor representatives.
Copy of Incident Action Plan (IAP) or other relevant plan.

tasks.category: Establish effective relationships with relevant personnel.
tasks.verbatim_text: Conduct self in a professional manner.
clarifications: Respectful of public and private property.

tasks.category: Establish effective relationships with relevant personnel.
tasks.verbatim_text: Establish and maintain positive interpersonal and interagency working relationships.

tasks.category: Establish effective relationships with relevant personnel.
tasks.verbatim_text: Contact personnel relevant to assignment.
clarifications: Geographic Area Human Resource Specialist Coordinator.
Host unit contacts for Human Resources, Employee Relations, and Contracting.

tasks.category: Understand and comply with ICS concepts and principles.
tasks.verbatim_text: Apply the ICS.

tasks.category: Ensure relevant information is exchanged during briefings and debriefings.
tasks.verbatim_text: Obtain briefing from immediate supervisor and Incident Commander within the first operational period.
clarifications: Information on situations from current/previous Human Resource Specialist assigned.
Update incident information by the beginning of each operational period.

tasks.category: Ensure relevant information is exchanged during briefings and debriefings.
tasks.verbatim_text: Conduct appropriate periodic briefings at predetermined times and location to keep cooperating agencies informed of problems, concerns, and issues.
clarifications: Actions taken involving the cooperating agency.
Copies of information gathered and supplied to the agency representative.

tasks.category: Ensure relevant information is exchanged during briefings and debriefings.
tasks.verbatim_text: Present pertinent human resource messages.
clarifications: IAP or other relevant plan, daily.

tasks.category: Ensure documentation is complete and disposition is appropriate.
tasks.verbatim_text: Maintain ICS 214, Unit Log and file with the Documentation Unit at the end of each operational period.

tasks.category: Ensure documentation is complete and disposition is appropriate.
tasks.verbatim_text: Complete contact information sheet for contacts involving civil rights or requiring fact-finding or conflict/problem resolution.
clarifications: Send Contact Information Report to the Geographic Area Human Resource Specialist Coordinator at the end of an assignment.

tasks.category: Ensure documentation is complete and disposition is appropriate.
tasks.verbatim_text: Provide appropriate documentation for the Incident Management Team (IMT) as well as home and host units.

tasks.category: Gather, produce and distribute information as required by established guidelines and ensure understanding by recipient.
tasks.verbatim_text: Establish a bulletin board for messages and current information.

tasks.category: Gather, produce and distribute information as required by established guidelines and ensure understanding by recipient.
tasks.verbatim_text: Attend incident planning and command staff meetings as required.

tasks.category: Gather, produce and distribute information as required by established guidelines and ensure understanding by recipient.
tasks.verbatim_text: Interact and coordinate with command and general staff.
clarifications: Provide accurate and timely advice assistance.

tasks.category: Gather, produce and distribute information as required by established guidelines and ensure understanding by recipient.
tasks.verbatim_text: Provide input on demobilization priorities.
clarifications: Obtain assisting and cooperating agency input to the demobilization process.
Communicate demobilization information to cooperating and assisting agencies at least one operational period prior to demobilization.

tasks.category: Follow established procedures and/or safety procedures relevant to given assignment.
tasks.verbatim_text: Ensure oral and written human resources messages are consistent with relevant federal/local laws, regulations, and policies.

tasks.category: Follow established procedures and/or safety procedures relevant to given assignment.
tasks.verbatim_text: Provide for the safety and welfare of assigned resources.
clarifications: Communicate potential hazardous or inappropriate work situations.
Ensure special precautions are taken and work rest guidelines are followed.
Council subordinates immediately if deficient performance occurs.

tasks.category: Effectively advise and assist in resolving human resource issues that occur during the incident or event.
tasks.verbatim_text: Provide accurate and timely advice and assistance to successfully resolve conflicts between parties.
clarifications: Fulfill requests for information or refer requester to appropriate source for information, within the work period request was made.

tasks.category: Effectively advise and assist in resolving human resource issues that occur during the incident or event.
tasks.verbatim_text: Take steps through appropriate lines of authority to resolve problems within the first operational period.
clarifications: Inform parties of intent to ascertain facts surrounding the situation or problem.
Interview parties involved to gather and document facts.
Follow-up with managers/supervisors within the operational period to ensure their expectations were met.

If problems or requests remain unsolved or incomplete after follow-up, advise management they should be addressed with the cooperating agency and agency representative, and provide supporting documentation.
Advise immediate supervisor of concerns related to multi-agency involvement.
Use diplomacy in the resolution of concerns.

tasks.category: Plan for demobilization and ensure demobilization procedures are followed.
tasks.verbatim_text: Demobilize and check out.
clarifications: Receive demobilization instructions from incident supervisor.
If required, complete ICS 221, Demobilization Checkout and submit completed form to the appropriate person.
